  • Master’s Degree in Business, Management, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with military-based training models and DoD programs is strongly preferred.

  • No clearance required for this position.

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24⁄7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

As Product Manager for Crypto, you will own key feature execution and user flows for our customer-facing crypto product suite, including trading, staking, and on-chain deposits and withdrawals. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Compliance, and Legal to turn complex regulatory and technical requirements into seamless retail experiences. This is a high-impact opportunity for a highly autonomous PM eager to shape regulated crypto products across Europe under frameworks like MICA.

What you’ll do

  • Take end-to-end ownership of a dedicated area within the crypto product suite from initial discovery through release and continuous iteration.
  • Run comprehensive product discovery to frame problems, define hypotheses, and validate solutions with users and data before committing engineering effort.
  • Write clear, structured product requirements and partner with designers on user flows to ensure engineering and compliance teams can execute without ambiguity.

  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Credit & Pricing
jobs.jd_full:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product Team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the Role

As a Staff Product Manager on Affirm’s Credit & Pricing team, you’ll shape how consumers discover, understand, and use available credit. You’ll own the strategy for credit experiences spanning shopping, repayment, and marketing, turning complex credit capabilities into intuitive products that build trust and drive activation, conversion, and repeat engagement.

What You’ll Do

  • Set the product direction. Define a cohesive vision for consumer credit experiences, identify the most valuable problems to solve, and translate your strategy into priorities across multiple teams.
  • Build experiences that make credit understandable. Help consumers explore potential financing options before checkout, discover where they have purchasing power, and understand when credit becomes available again after repayment.
  • Create more relevant consumer journeys. Develop personalized experiences for new and returning consumers, using research and experimentation to determine what information, guidance, and next steps best meet their needs.
  • Connect platform capabilities to consumer outcomes. Own merchant prequalification and purchasing power experiences, partnering with core purchasing power and credit decisioning teams to translate underlying capabilities into clear, consistent experiences.
  • Lead consequential product decisions. Bring Engineering, Design, Analytics, Credit, Marketing, Commercial, and Legal partners together to resolve tradeoffs across consumer needs, growth, risk, and partner commitments. Influence senior leaders through clear recommendations and sound judgment.
  • Own measurable results. Define success, lead discovery and experimentation, and use funnel analysis and consumer feedback to improve activation, purchase conversion, repeat engagement, and comprehension while supporting responsible access to credit.

What We Look For

  • A record of building impactful consumer products. 7+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated success taking products from discovery through launch and scaling adoption in fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces, or similarly complex environments.
  • Leadership across teams. Experience independently setting direction for a substantial product area, influencing senior stakeholders, and aligning multiple teams around priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong consumer product judgment. An ability to translate complex systems into intuitive experiences, with a high bar for interaction design, clear communication, and consumer trust.
  • Strategic and technical depth. You connect long-term opportunities to practical product and platform decisions, and work effectively with engineers on capabilities that serve multiple experiences.
  • Analytical and experimental rigor. You combine customer research, behavioral data, and well-designed experiments to prioritize opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and decide what to scale, change, or stop.
  • Ownership in ambiguity. You bring structure to open-ended problems, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and communicate the rationale, risks, and support needed to move forward.
  • Relevant domain curiosity. Experience with credit, lending, personalization, or AI-powered consumer experiences is a plus. You can learn complex domains quickly and distinguish useful innovation from technology without a clear customer need.

Pay Grade - PEquity Grade - 13

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

jobs.title: Software Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
SI-BONE is a fast-growing, publicly traded medical device company that is an industry pioneer in minimally invasive sacropelvic solutions. Our mission is to help patients rise up and reach for the stars, and our vision is to work together as the global leader to make sacropelvic conditions universally recognized and effectively treated through innovation, evidence, education, and advocacy.

Job Title: Software Product Manager

Independent Contractor (Consultant) - Part-Time

Location: Remote (USA)

Travel: Up to 1-4 trips per year for R&D laboratory support

SI-BONE® is focused on helping patients in one of the most under-served, under-diagnosed, and under-treated areas in orthopedics, the sacroiliac (SI) joint. SI-BONE developed an innovative, patented implant to fuse the SI joint. The iFuse Implant System® provides a less invasive alternative to traditional sacroiliac (SI) joint fusion surgery and has been used in over 90,000 procedures to date.

We are a medical device company that is focused on improving the lives of patients with sacroiliac pelvic conditions. We are looking for people who are passionate about our mission and who are willing to work hard to achieve it. We are also looking for people who are:

  • Agile: We work in a fast-paced environment and need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly.
  • Creative: We embrace creativity, and we need people who are not afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Team Players: We roll-up our sleeves and work together as one team to achieve our goals.

General Responsibilities:

The Software Product Manager will play a key role in the upstream development and potential commercialization efforts of a software solution for SI-BONE’s spinopelvic portfolio. This individual will engage primarily in upstream product management activities to support UX / UI, software application design, and software verification and validation. Working closely with cross-functional teams, and in a consultative capacity alongside SI-BONE’s existing product managers, the Software Product Manager will support the definition and development of a pre-operative planning application and will help ensure the continued success of SI-BONE’s emerging product lines and help identify and evaluate new opportunities to grow the company’s portfolio. The ideal candidate is a proactive, high-energy contributor who brings passion, curiosity, and a hands-on approach to every aspect of the product development process.

The Software Product Manager must always act and conduct company business in an honest, ethical and strictly legal manner, complying with the Code of Conduct, other company policies, the AdvaMed Code and all applicable laws and regulations, whether national, regional, state or local. This individual is encouraged, expected and required to report any suspected violations of laws, regulations, the Code or any other Company policy, and all other suspected unethical behavior. The company does not tolerate retaliation in connection with making good faith reports of suspected violations.

Responsible for performing all duties in compliance with all applicable worldwide regulatory requirements as included in the scope of the SI-BONE Quality Manual.

Specific Responsibilities and Skills:

  • Collaborate with SI-BONE’s product development and engineering team to provide input on software product development

  • Lead strategy surrounding UX / UI and software application design

  • Provide input on strategy for gathering and synthesizing User requirements and inputs.

  • Work cross-functionally with engineering and regulatoryteams and design surgeons to develop and launch new products.

  • Collaborate with commercial and strategy teams to identify new market opportunities, partnerships, and growth initiatives aligned with the product roadmap. Conduct market research, support business case development, and contribute to go-to-market planning for new products or enhancements.

  • Support the SI-BONE Quality System.

  • Author and maintain user requirements, product requirements, and user stories, and manage the backlog and release scope with engineering.

  • Plan and run voice-of-customer and usability activities with surgeons and OR staff, and translate findings into design inputs and workflow decisions.

  • Partner with Regulatory and Quality on software risk analysis, intended use and indications statements, and the software documentation required for submission.

  • Review verification and validation protocols and results from a user-needs perspective, and support human factors validation.

  • Establish and document software product management practices — templates, review cadences, and decision records — that SI-BONE product managers can carry forward independently.

Knowledge, Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with minimum of 2-4 years of experience; or Master’s Degree.

  • 2+ years of software product management or product marketing or sales support experience, ideally in the medical device industry (a plus if in spine).

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare or another regulated field strongly desired (a plus if in spine).

  • Hands-on experience with pre-operative planning, surgical navigation, or 3D image-based software — including DICOM workflows, CT/MRI segmentation, and implant templating or measurement tools.

  • Working knowledge of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) development and the standards that govern it, including IEC 62304 software lifecycle, IEC 62366 usability engineering, ISO 14971 risk management as applied to software, and FDA premarket software and cybersecurity guidance.

  • Familiarity with software verification and validation in a design-controlled environment: requirements traceability, test protocol review, defect triage, and design history file documentation.

  • Experience contributing to regulatory strategy for software, including 510(k)/De Novo pathways, clinical decision support versus device determinations, and AI/ML-enabled device considerations, in partnership with Regulatory and Quality.

  • Ability to operate in an agile, iterative development cadence while meeting design control and documentation requirements.

  • Experience managing external software development partners or contract engineering firms — scoping statements of work, reviewing deliverables, and holding vendors to schedule and quality commitments.

  • Ability to translate surgeon and OR workflow observations into user needs, requirements, and wireframes; direct experience running voice-of-customer interviews, formative usability studies, and design surgeon panels.

  • Data literacy sufficient to define analytics, telemetry, and success metrics for a clinical software product.

  • Able to work in a high-performing team environment and possess a demonstrated ability to multi-task and accommodate changing priorities within compressed timelines.

  • Demonstrated self-starter, with ability to work independently and prioritize time and resources.

  • Proven track record of success and teamwork, with a strong dedication to excellence and customer satisfaction.

  • Consultative operating style: able to embed with an existing product team, ramp quickly with minimal onboarding, and add value without displacing internal ownership.

  • Willingness to coach and upskill SI-BONE product managers on software-specific practices, leaving behind repeatable templates and processes.

  • Strong written deliverable discipline — product requirements documents, user requirement specifications, roadmaps, and decision memos that stand on their own for reviewers who were not in the room.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity; able to frame a problem and recommend a path forward where none has been defined.

  • Credibility to influence engineering, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders without direct authority, and sound judgment on when to escalate versus decide.

  • Highly skilled with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Delivery Manager

Location: Remote, United States

Type: Full-time

Base Salary: $150,000

Bonus: $15,000 (based on annual performance)

Travel: up to 15%

Must be authorized to work in the United States.

About Data Meaning

Data Meaning is a Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting firm. We deliver tailored solutions in business intelligence, data warehousing, data strategy, and project delivery for clients across the United States and beyond. Our consultants work remotely as one team, with a collaborative, inclusive, and delivery-focused culture.

Position Summary

We are hiring a mid-level Delivery Manager to own day-to-day delivery of client engagements from kickoff through close. This is a hands-on delivery role. You will typically run two to four concurrent projects — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and client communication — and keep internal teams and client stakeholders aligned.

This is not a practice-lead, people-manager, or sales role. You will flag staffing needs and expansion opportunities, follow established delivery standards, and escalate early. The right profile has about five to eight years of experience, including real time as a delivery or project manager on consulting or professional-services engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery management

  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned client engagements, including timelines, budgets, deliverables, and client expectations. Typical load is two to four concurrent projects.

  • Lead project planning, estimation, and scoping in partnership with Sales, Implementation, and Professional Services.

  • Coordinate and prioritize work across internal and client teams so delivery stays on time and on quality.

  • Coordinate staffing for assigned accounts with the practice lead; raise capacity and utilization issues early rather than owning practice-wide resource planning.

  • Identify, track, and mitigate risks, issues, dependencies, and scope changes; escalate clearly and early.

  • Run delivery governance for assigned work: status reporting, steering updates, sprint and milestone reviews, and stakeholder communication.

  • Create and maintain project documentation including roadmaps, project plans, RAID logs, and resource plans.

  • Keep repositories for deliverables, budgets, and project documentation current; track financial performance of assigned projects against forecast.

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned clients and protect satisfaction through the life of the engagement.

  • Surface expansion and follow-on opportunities to Sales and account leadership. You do not own a sales quota or book of business.

  • Follow firm delivery processes, standards, and templates, and suggest practical improvements from the work.

Requirements and stakeholder management

  • Partner with clients to understand business challenges and turn them into clear, deliverable requirements.

  • Facilitate requirements and planning sessions, and make sure acceptance criteria are agreed and documented.

  • Work with technical teams to confirm that solutions match the agreed scope, timeline, and quality bar.

  • Review deliverables against acceptance criteria and flag quality, timeline, or adoption gaps to the technical lead.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5–8 years of professional experience.

  • At least 3–5 of those years as a project or delivery manager on client engagements.

  • Consulting or professional-services background strongly preferred. In-house project management alone is not the target profile.

  • Proven success running more than one engagement at a time without dropping the fundamentals: estimation, planning, budgeting, RAID, status, and stakeholder alignment.

  • Strong command of delivery fundamentals: estimation, planning, budgeting, resource coordination, and risk management.

  • Experience tracking project financials (budget vs. forecast, margin, utilization) on the accounts you own.

  • Working fluency with common project management tools and frameworks — for example Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Monday.com, or comparable planning and tracking tools — and comfort with Agile, waterfall, and hybrid delivery.

  • AI fluent: regular, practical use of AI tools to draft status, summarize meetings, organize project documentation, and prepare stakeholder updates. You remain accountable for accuracy. Specific model or vendor experience is not required.

  • Excellent organization and time management; able to prioritize across competing demands.

  • Clear verbal and written communication, including status and issue communication with client managers and occasional executives.

  • Proactive, self-directed, and effective in a fully remote environment.

  • Authorized to work in the United States.

  • Willing and able to travel up to 15%.

Preferred

  • Project management certification (PMP or equivalent). Not a gate.

  • Experience delivering work in a data, analytics, or technology professional-services setting. Tool-level analytics skills are not required.

  • Familiarity with professional-services operations (staffing requests, utilization, work-in-progress, and change orders).

What this role is not

  • Not a junior coordinator role and not a senior practice lead.

  • Not a people-manager role. You coordinate contributors on assigned projects; you do not own hiring, coaching, or a reporting team.

  • Not a technical or analytics individual-contributor role. You do not need Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or other analytics tools.

  • Not a quota-carrying sales or account-growth role.

Success in the first six months

  • Take ownership of an assigned portfolio and run it with clean plans, RAID logs, status, and financial tracking.

  • Keep clients informed so surprises are rare and escalations happen early.

  • Work cleanly with delivery, sales, and technical leads using the firm’s existing tools and templates.

  • Use AI tools as a default part of how you prepare project artifacts, without handing off judgment.

Data Meaning is an equal opportunity employer.

Project Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Program Recruitment

Part-Time Freelance, Approximately 20 Hours per Week

Position Summary

Research To Practice is seeking a part-time Project Manager to support strategic partnership development, institution recruitment, and external engagement across multiple oncology educational initiatives.

This individual will identify and recruit medical oncology practices, academic cancer centers, community oncology groups, patient advocacy organizations, professional societies, and other healthcare stakeholders. The Project Manager will manage outreach and recruitment pipelines, coordinate partnership activities, maintain accurate records, and analyze recruitment and participation data.

The ideal candidate has experience in project management, healthcare marketing, relationship management, data analysis, and oncology. This individual should be highly organized, comfortable communicating with a range of external stakeholders, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

Grand Rounds Institution Recruitment

  • Identify and recruit medical oncology practices, cancer centers, academic institutions, health systems, and community oncology groups for Grand Rounds participation.
  • Conduct and coordinate outreach to physicians, administrators, education coordinators, and other institutional contacts.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective, interested, confirmed, and scheduled institutions.
  • Manage recruitment timelines, follow-up activities, and program-specific goals.
  • Develop relationships with participating institutions to support repeat participation in future programs.

Strategic Partnerships and Patient Advocacy Engagement

Project Management

  • Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and communication among internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate project plans, recruitment trackers, contact records, and status reports.
  • Identify and resolve barriers to recruitment, participation, and project execution.
  • Coordinate with RTP’s scientific, marketing, meetings, outcomes, production, and project management teams.

Marketing and Outreach

  • Support targeted email, telephone, and other outreach efforts designed to recruit institutions and engage external partners.
  • Collaborate with marketing staff to develop recruitment and engagement strategies.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Analyze trends in institutional recruitment and external partnership activity.
  • Prepare regular status reports for leadership and project teams.
  • Use data to identify high-potential institutions, organizations, and future partnership opportunities.
  • Recommend process improvements based on recruitment and participation data.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of project management experience.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical education, patient advocacy, nonprofit organizations, or a related field.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience working with recruitment, marketing, participation, or engagement data.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Excel, databases, trackers, and project management tools.
  • Ability to work independently and provide clear, consistent progress reporting.

Preferred

  • Experience in oncology or hematology.
  • Experience working with patient advocacy organizations.
  • Experience recruiting healthcare institutions, physicians, or healthcare professionals.
  • Familiarity with academic cancer centers, hospital systems, and community oncology practices.
  • Experience with continuing medical education or healthcare educational programming.
  • Experience using CRM systems, email marketing platforms, or contact databases.

Time Commitment

  • Approximately 20 hours per week.
  • Flexibility to participate in occasional meetings or outreach across US time zones.

Measures of Success

  • Achievement of institution and partner recruitment goals.
  • Development of an active pipeline of prospective host institutions and external partners.
  • Timely and consistent outreach and follow-up.
  • Accuracy of recruitment, partnership, and project tracking.
  • Growth in new and repeat institutional participation.
  • Development of productive relationships with patient advocacy organizations and other strategic partners.
  • Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.
